credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/seagrass.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. BOBBING: five short ribbons, their tips bent toward the foe, rising from a creeping rhizome node on sand. Sea green / deep teal-green. Gesture: a current wave travels from rooted base to ribbon tips, then rebounds and settles; the rhizome and spathe stay fixed. Sport: natural greener foliage; no named colour form identified.
